config.what: every physics and control formula, restated dimensionally and tied to its source line

checks.name: dynamic pressure  q = 0.5 rho U^2
Reynolds number  Re = rho U c / mu
circulatory lift  L = q S CL
reduced frequency  k = |omega_s| c / (2 U)
checks.note: dimensionally a reduced frequency; kinematically a reduced *pitch rate* -- omega_s is the instantaneous rate about the span axis, not the flapping angular frequency.  See MATH_AUDIT F-02.

checks.name: LEV blend  lev = clip(k / 0.30, 0, 1)
checks.implicit_unit: none -- 0.30 is a reduced frequency, correctly dimensionless

checks.name: stall angle  alpha_stall = 11 deg + 26 deg * lev
checks.implicit_unit: 11.0 and 26.0 are degrees, made explicit by np.radians

checks.name: low-Re stall knockdown  0.55 + 0.45 log10(Re)/5
checks.implicit_unit: the 5.0 divides log10(Re); it is 5 decades of Reynolds number, i.e. Re=1e5 is the anchor where the factor reaches 1.0.  Nothing in the code says so.

checks.name: finite-wing lift slope  2 pi / (1 + 2/AR)
checks.note: per radian; radian is dimensionless so this is [1].

checks.name: induced drag  cd_i = CL^2 / (pi e AR)
skin friction, laminar branch  1.328 / sqrt(Re)
skin friction, turbulent branch  0.074 / Re^0.2
skin friction blend centre  log10(Re) - 5.7
checks.implicit_unit: 5.7 is log10(Re) at the transition centre, i.e. Re = 5.0e5; the 4.0 is 1/decade of blend width.

checks.name: Kramer rotational force  C_rot rho U omega c^2 dr
strip added mass  rho pi c^2 / 4 per unit span
bluff added mass  Ca rho V
added rotational inertia  m_add * lever^2
buoyancy  rho g V f_sub
slam force  |d(m_add)/dt * v_n|
checks.note: FluidDiagnostics.slam is documented as a force in N; transitions.py divides it by an area to get a pressure.

checks.name: bound circulation  Gamma = 0.5 CL U c
checks.note: Kutta-Joukowski: L' = rho U Gamma with L' in N/m.

checks.name: bluff axial force  0.5 rho |v| v (Cd A_front + Cf A_wet)
bluff cross-flow force  0.5 rho u_c^2 Cd_cross A_side
hydrostatic pressure  p_atm + rho g h
Airy deep-water orbital speed  a omega e^{kz}
geometric viscosity blend  mu_a^(1-f) mu_w^f
checks.implicit_unit: raising a dimensional quantity to a non-integer power is only meaningful because both factors carry the same unit and the exponents sum to 1.  It is a weighted geometric mean, and it is dimensionally sound *only* for that reason.

checks.name: jet thrust  rho Q^2 / A
jet volume rate from joint rate  -V0 f omega / span
checks.implicit_unit: `span` is a joint-angle range in radians, so it is dimensionless and omega/span has units of 1/s.

checks.name: tube second moment  pi (ro^4 - ri^4) / 4
section modulus  Z = I / ro
elliptic root moment  L_semi b 4/(3 pi)
bending stress  sigma = M / Z
flap angular acceleration  alpha = A (2 pi f)^2
swept-surface root moment  0.5 rho omega^2 Cd int(c r^3 dr)
checks.note: the integral int(c(r) r^3 dr) carries m.m^3.m = m^5, not m^4; getting that wrong is exactly what this check is for.

checks.name: inertial reversal moment  M = I alpha
cantilever tip deflection  q L^4 / (8 E I)
hoop stress  p r / t
shell buckling  E/(1-nu^2) (t/r)^3
checks.note: dimensionally sound; the *coefficient* is the (t/D)^3 one applied to (t/r)^3.  See MATH_AUDIT S-01.

checks.name: Wagner slam pressure  0.5 rho v^2 (pi/tan beta)^2
flat-panel slam bending  0.30 p b^2 / t^2
net buoyancy  rho g V - m g
ballast pump power  dp Q / eta
copper loss  (tau / km)^2
viscous loss  k_visc omega^2
checks.implicit_unit: k_visc is documented as 'N.m per rad/s', which is N.m.s -- consistent.

checks.name: iron loss  k_iron omega
checks.implicit_unit: k_iron = 0.02 * p_cont / 1000.0 is built from a POWER and a bare 1000.  For p_iron to be a power, k_iron must be W/(rad/s), so the 1000 is a reference speed of 1000 rad/s.  Nothing in the code says so.  See MATH_AUDIT E-01.

checks.name: motor constant  km ~ mass^0.75
checks.implicit_unit: 0.05 is N.m/sqrt(W) at a reference mass of 0.1 kg; 0.88 is BLDC_OUTRUNNER.efficiency_peak written as a literal, so editing that table entry rescales km for every motor class.  See MATH_AUDIT E-02.

checks.name: stall torque  km sqrt(P) G eta
CPG joint command  offset + A sin(2 pi f t + phi)
checks.note: joint angles are radians, hence dimensionless.  The CPG parameter vector therefore mixes radians (amplitude, phase, offset) with Hz (frequency) in one flat array.  See MATH_AUDIT C-01.

checks.name: twist scaling  [1,1,1,0.3,0.3,0.3]
checks.implicit_unit: the three 0.3s must be a LENGTH in metres for an angular rate in rad/s to be commensurable with a linear rate in m/s.  Written as a bare number.  Every singular value, `reach`, cond(A) and the damping lambda inherit it.  See MATH_AUDIT C-02.

checks.name: damping  lam = 0.01 tr(G)/r
checks.implicit_unit: G = A A^T carries (twist per coefficient)^2, so lam does too and the ridge is relative.  The additive 1e-12 is NOT: it is a bare number added to a dimensional one. It only survives because it is negligible except when tr(G) is exactly zero, which is the case it exists for. See MATH_AUDIT C-03.
